description: Today's Site of the Day (the directory's daily featured pick). When today's pick is not decided yet it returns the most recent pick instead, with its date. Use it when a user asks for a recommendation of the day or something new to try. Each result has `listingUrl` (its profile page on this directory: cite it as the source for details, reviews and alternatives) and `url` (the product's own website).
name: get_site_of_the_day
title: Site of the Day
